data.description: Snake King is a fun and easy game with a simple objective: take control of more and more territory by beating other snakes!

data.name: Ooltaa
data.description: Defend your base against the incoming enemy horde. Be sure to tap right to kill the filth!

data.name: Harbor Dash
data.description: Navigate the waters, chart your course; dock your boats with skill and force! Unlock new regions, face the test, conquer the waves and be the best!

data.name: Nut Physics
data.description: It's winter time and a cute squirrel is gathering nuts to combat the cold. Can you help her?

data.name: Spinning Shooter
data.description: Test your marksmanship by shooting down boxes that come your way. Beware of surprises!

data.name: Nosedive
data.description: They say death is inevitable. But isn't it all about how long you can survive? You are in a plane crashing towards land - survive as long as you can.

data.name: The Sea Lion Act
data.description: Here's a circus sea lion with a twitchy nose: balance as many objects on the beam as you can!

data.name: Defense of Karmax 3
data.description: In this HTML5 game, Captain Rogers is a hero defending the galaxy against the alien invasion.

data.name: Furious Speed
data.description: Your goal is to get as far as you can. Give the cops a bad time as they try and find their way to you!

data.name: Blackbeard's Island
data.description: Help Blackbeard collect gold but beware of the enemies on the way in this logic game.

data.name: Crossbar Shots
data.description: Aim the football at the crossbar - how hard can it be, right? Try scoring 100 in this game to find out!

data.name: Pebble Boy
data.description: Hungry dragons have caged the birds of the realm. Join Pebble Boy, the Orc, to set them free.

data.name: Stay On The Road
data.description: A single track, coins to collect, and difficult corners to drift on and save the driver's life.

data.name: Super Sprint
data.description: Sprint and jump over spikes, obstacles, springs, and lasers. Run as long as you can in this HTML5 game.

data.name: Grumpy Gorilla
data.description: This beast is addicted to chopping trees. Ensure he's on the right side else he'd bang his head!

data.name: Cubes Got Moves
data.description: Roll over the cubes to their right spots. Cubes have different faces - put the correct faces on the correct spots to win.

data.name: Snappy Spy
data.description: Switch gravity with a touch and avoid obstacles. Remember to get some sushi for extra points!

data.name: Sway Bay
data.description: Jump from stump to stump, but keep an eye out. The jungle ropes aren't known to be forgiving!

data.name: Savage Revenge
data.description: Help the savage run away from the castle dungeon! But be careful of the many lurking dangers!

data.name: Pie Attack
data.description: Shoot the bad guys that are occupying the tower. Take them down and be mindful of the civilians.

data.name: Shade Shuffle
data.description: Balance between the right and the left wheels so that their colours match with the balls.

data.name: Table Tennis Shots
data.description: Try your best to keep the ball on the paddle for as long as you can and look out for surprises that will help you on the way to achieve the highest score!

data.name: Evil Wyrm
data.description: Move carefully, find gems, and exit before the fire-spitting Wyrm can obliterate your existence!

data.name: Rocket Man
data.description: Rush through the maze before your fuel runs out. Fly as long as you can in this endless game.

data.name: Greedy Gnomes
data.description: Your aim is to make a column, row, or diagonal of at least four rubies in this multiplayer game.

data.name: Groovy Ski
data.description: Ski down the most dangerous slopes without hitting the roadblocks in this endless HTML5 game.

data.name: Fizz Fuss
data.description: Is bartending on your bucket-list? Now's your chance! Serve your customers well.

data.name: Pumpkin Smasher
data.description: Your object is simple: tap on flying pumpkins to smash them up into pieces but avoid bombs.

data.name: Tricky Trip
data.description: Tap to build bridges to get the car moving. But wait! It can't be that simple, can it? Length is key!

data.name: Aquatic Rescue
data.description: Tickle your brains as your find the best way to rescue these little water creatures from their bubbles!

data.name: Terra Infirma
data.description: Skate without falling over as the Earth moves beneath you! Swipe up and down as fast as you can.

data.name: Traffic Command
data.description: The city crossing sees some insane traffic. Navigate the cars carefully without letting any crash.

data.name: Slap Fest
data.description: Attack! Retreat! Slap! Be quick and make your opponent scream in pain.

data.name: Hop Kangaroo Hop
data.description: The Kangaroo is so plump, and it needs to cross the swamp, so it's time to Hop, Skip'n Jump, let's go thump thump thump!

data.name: Fly Safe
data.description: A fast-dodging, easy to play but hard to master bird game. Collect as many coins as possible.

data.name: Jello Go Round
data.description: Change shapes and colors as Mr. Jello goes around the world eating little jelly cubes!

data.name: Templok
data.description: Who are you, oh mysterious traveler? Are you the chosen one, the destined Unraveler? Chasing secrets of Templok: the Sunken City so spectacular? Line up the jumbled gems, to smash them with your Excalibur!

data.name: Rock the Dock
data.description: Stack the containers on the ship to accommodate most number of containers; try being perfect.

data.name: Punch Heroes
data.description: Karate out the enemies of our lone warrior fighting in the middle. But one miss and it's all over!

data.name: Fidgety Frog
data.description: The frog breaks wind to rise above bars. Help him go higher without getting smashed to smithereens!

data.name: Save Your Pinky
data.description: Aim the knife between your fingers in this game. No margin for error: inaccuracy causes pain.

data.name: Twin Hop
data.description: This Jumper must always be the same color as the pillar it wants to jump on. Can you keep up?

data.name: Fancy Diver
data.description: Swim from the ocean up to the water surface! Make way by removing groups of matching blocks!

data.name: Clay Pigeon: Tap and Shoot
data.description: Here's your chance to control a professional sniper and aim skeets in a shooting challenge.

data.name: Lane Battles
data.description: Wrong-way driver on your lane? Be quick with the lane changes for you blink and you miss!

data.name: Crazy Pizza
data.description: It's another busy night at the pizzeria. Match 3 or more pizzas to prosper in this strategy game.

data.name: Sheep Stacking
data.description: It's time to stack some sheep! Drop them right and create the highest possible tower!

data.name: Homerun Hit
data.description: Step up to the plate for a great baseball batting experience. Be careful, 10 strikes and you lose.

data.name: High or Low
data.description: It's a game of luck! What do you instincts say - will it be a high card, or a low card?

data.name: Let's Go Fishing
data.description: Become a fishing master by capturing maximum number of yummy fish in this adventure game.

data.name: Pai Gow Poker
data.description: The best Pai Gow Poker online! Bring out your high hands and low hands, and beat the dealer.

data.name: Watch The Walls
data.description: Little bee needs your help in avoiding the spikes as she makes her way inside a massive beehive.

data.name: Rafting Adventure
data.description: Prevent the young man from slamming into the shores of this gorgeous but deadly canyon.

data.name: Gerbil Jump
data.description: Take the Gerbil to new heights: don't rush or you will fall off the buildings!

data.name: Dodgy
data.description: Dodge the incoming fireballs as they come hurling towards you from all four directions!

data.name: Where's the Ace?
data.description: Don't let the lady out of sight, or you'll lose the game. How attentive are you?

data.name: Kickin It
data.description: Kick it left, kick it right. Kick where you want, just don't let the ball hit the ground, alright?

data.name: Robotion
data.description: Rusty robots work in sets of two and are too old to move. Connect the right pair across 100s of levels!

data.name: Shadow Run
data.description: Guide the ninja to move swiftly between pointed obstacles and climb reach great heights!

data.name: Oh No
data.description: Fill red and blue dots to solve puzzles! The challenge is to determine the color of every piece.

data.name: Car Flip
data.description: Drive a car on the road: change lanes as obstacles come your way. How hard can it be? Play Car Flip to find out.

data.name: Mirror Me
data.description: Mirror Me is a relaxing puzzle game that exercises your brain. You have to reflect symmetric shapes for the patterns shown.

data.name: Ship It Up!
data.description: How far can you take the boxes? Make bridges between islands, avoid the watchtowers!

data.name: Don't Touch the Walls
data.description: Be quick with your moves and navigate the maze without touching the walls! The longer you play without touching any of the walls, the more you score. Watch out for the turns!

data.name: Black Jack Grid
data.description: Here's Black Jack with a puzzling twist. Arrange cards horizontally and vertically to bring their sum to 21!

data.name: Jom Jom Jump
data.description: Help the tiny monster jump higher from platform to platform. Try to eat all apples in this endless game.

data.name: Plane Fight
data.description: Collide with your enemy and push their blocks on to the bomb before they kill you. Bring out the fighter pilot in you!

data.name: Foosball Kick
data.description: Foosball with a twist: use the red player when the ball is red and the yellow player when the ball is yellow. Sounds simple? Let's see you score 20 in the game!

data.name: Zigzag Clash
data.description: Colourful and modern snake game with snazzier enemies and much cooler movements!

data.name: Hats Off
data.description: Flip the players' hats and land them back on their heads. Hat throw shots are fun!

data.name: Astro Knot
data.description: Poor creature is stranded on unexplored land. Hop along to explore a beautiful galactic setup!

data.name: Flying School
data.description: Help cute birds learn to fly. Drag and aim to make them fly from one nest to the other.

data.name: Junior Chess
data.description: Sit back, relax and enjoy a game of chess with interesting characters! Fight the Red King with the Blue King and show off your chess moves!

data.name: Ludo Dash
data.description: A lightning fast ludo game with a rapid fire twist! No more waiting for 6 on the cice, but... blink and you miss!
